name: RetireOnSol
short_description: SOL accumulation & retirement planning with Monte Carlo simulations
long_description: Plan your SOL accumulation and retirement journey with RetireOnSol. Features two modes: GROW to project your portfolio value using Monte Carlo simulations with CAGR and Power Law models, and SPEND to plan your retirement drawdown with success probability analysis. Connect your wallet to see current holdings, use live SOL price updates, and visualize 500+ simulation paths. Includes inflation-adjusted returns, DCA strategy planning, and shareable projection images.
